decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:20. The stope has 243 t at 11.9 g/t, about 93 oz. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.2 oz per hour. It takes 0.65 h to travel, then loads at 25.4 t/h. That is roughly 75 t (about 28 oz) before the likely repair time, and up to about 60 oz if it stays to 17:00. The cost is about 1.5 oz. The Norte stockpile is 238 of 450 t, so it won't fill and truck limits don't bind. I kept LH-09 on the critical-path heading, which costs 4 oz per hour.

Keep LH-08 at N600-09 (11.9 g/t, 227 t, cheap 0.2 oz/h dev cost). LH-02 is down at N522-15 (288 t at 10.9 g/t, likely repair 16:00), so send LH-10 there. It is free at 11:00 and takes 0.65 h to travel, so it starts about 11:40. That gives about 5.3 h x 25.4 t/h = 135 t, or about 47 oz. Norte is slightly truck-limited, but the stockpile has 193 t of room, so the extra ore still counts. I did not take LH-09 from the critical-path heading (4 oz/h). I did not move LH-08 because it earns about the same where it is.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
